description: A white plastic chair-like model sits on a blue bedspread in front of a pink pillow, with a couple of small white block pieces nearby. The left hand stays low and stabilizes the chair body as a left-hand object, while the right hand reaches in from the right to pick up a small white block from the top area of the chair, lifts it slightly, then moves it down and to the right and sets it beside the other pieces, releasing it.
